name: Seeed reTerminal E1002
description: 7.3 inch 7-colour ACeP ePaper terminal, ESP32-S3, battery-powered. Speaks Tesserae's TRMNL BYOS endpoints once the device is flashed with TRMNL firmware.
notes_md: Awaiting confirmed test on real hardware. Flash with TRMNL firmware, point the device's API URL at your Tesserae base URL, and pair via the access token shown in Settings -> Devices.
